Subject: Post-signature: single-runbook MAP + close-to-live cadence

Hi Ben / Marissa,

Thanks again for the smooth contract signing — excited to get moving. To make sure we hit our July 15 go-live target, LedgerX put together a short list of deadlines we need to lock into the mutual action plan (MAP):

- Security review completion (SOC evidence) – due Jun 28 (Tom)
- Canary window and smoke tests – target Jul 6–8 (LedgerX ops + Redwood staging)
- Migration dry-run (data sync) – Jul 3 (LedgerX eng)
- Two training sessions for ops + support – Jul 9 and Jul 13 (apprentice + power-user)
- Final acceptance / sign-off — Jul 14 (Stakeholder committee)

I attached a first-pass MAP (LedgerX_MAP_v1.xlsx) with owners and proposed due dates. Can you confirm Redwood owners for the staging canary, the evaluation criteria (latency/99th, error rate, qualitative QA), and whether you can run a focused eval harness against sample prompts during the canary window?

Also: procurement asked for the finalized SOW + exec signature PDF — I see a DocuSign envelope but want to confirm it went through.

Appreciate a quick reply with owners and any changes to the timeline.

Best,
Elena
Elena Rossi
Head of Platform Integrations | LedgerX

Attachments: LedgerX_MAP_v1.xlsx

Elena — thanks for the clear list and the MAP. Sped through the worksheet and added Redwood owners inline; attaching a lightweight canary checklist (canary-checklist.pdf) that codifies the smoke tests we propose. High level:

- Redwood owners: Staging canary = Karthik Iyer (technical ops), Production cutover engineering = Ben Carter (deployment lead), Training & CS enablement = Marissa Cole.
- Evaluation harness: yes — we will run an automated eval over your 250 sample prompts during the Jul 6–8 window. Pass criteria we suggest: 95% success on functional prompts, P95 latency < 320ms, error rate < 0.5% (tokenization/model failures). We noted these in the MAP workbook.
- Migration: recommend a single dry-run on Jul 3 (non-peak), then a delta sync on Jul 12 before final cutover.
- Training: we can run a recorded upskilling session (60 mins) for ops on Jul 9 and a hands-on Q&A for power users on Jul 13. Marissa will own curriculum + materials.

Action items for you: confirm Tom (ops) is ok with Jul 6–8 for the canary window and share any restricted prompt sets we should treat as sensitive (PII). For procurement: I see DocuSign status: executed by Redwood, awaiting LedgerX exec sig (link included below).

Next steps:
- I’ll pull Karthik into the canary planning meeting. Can we do a 30-min sync Wed Jun 23 at 11:00 PT?
- Marissa will follow up with the training outline by Thu Jun 24.

Thanks — attaching both artifacts.

—
Ben Carter
Head of Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0147

Elena / Ben — jumping in on training. Draft plan (high level):

1) Ops training (Jul 9) — 60 minutes
   - Audience: LedgerX SREs + support engineers
   - Focus: deployment/rollback procedures, KV cache behavior during canary, metrics dashboard (Redwood Console), quick remediation playbook
   - Owner: Marissa Cole (materials + recording)

2) Power-user workshop (Jul 13) — 90 minutes
   - Audience: Product owners + analytics team
   - Focus: prompt evaluation guidelines, quality regression monitoring, using the eval harness and interpreting scorecards
   - Owner: Marissa Cole + Karthik for technical Q&A

Deliverables by Jun 24: training slides, a 12-step runbook excerpt for ops, and a short eval script to run during the canary that maps to your acceptance criteria.

Two quick clarifications:
- Will LedgerX want Redwood to host the training in your VPC (private deployment) or should we use Redwood-hosted Zoom + recordings? For privacy/regulatory reasons, if you prefer VPC-hosted sessions we’ll need a light network prep step two days prior.
- For the eval harness, do you have an internal scoring rubric (pass/fail) for semantic correctness, or do we use the Redwood default (semantic similarity + rule-based checks)?

If you confirm these two items, I’ll drop the slide deck and runbook into the shared Drive folder and send calendar invites.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
